assumption_to_test: explicit target fit plus unseen-case reproduction can make activation eligibility auditable without granting authority
smallest_testable_validation: extend the existing qif-ledger example with one local target, per-item applicability decisions, unseen cases, reproduction trials, and an assessment that remains insufficient when source trust is draft
expected_learning: whether the verifier can distinguish tested local fit from semantic truth and automatic activation
expected_cost: one bounded schema, verifier, fixture, documentation, and release slice
success_threshold: all positive tests and retained negative fixtures pass while missing context, evidence, independence, counterexample resolution, or agreement fails
